bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New features enhance user experience across Dev, Beta, and Canary Channels.
AI-Powered Copilot Mode in Edge - Enhances browsing with intelligent features for a seamless experience.
Azure Storage Mover Launch - Simplifies cloud-to-cloud data transfers, enhancing migration efficiency.
Microsoft Security Store Unveiled - A unified platform for security solutions and AI agents.
Gartner Recognition for Microsoft - Named a Leader in Distributed Hybrid Infrastructure for the third consecutive year.
